title: Learning from Multimodal Pseudo-Labels for Robust Open-Vocabulary Instance and Panoptic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.11681v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work addresses the challenge of open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) and open-set panoptic segmentation (OSPS), which aim to recognize both predefined and unseen object categories without exhaustive human annotations. Existing methods often suffer from noisy pseudo-masks, limited visual-textual grounding, and difficulty handling synonyms or out-of-vocabulary (OOV) words. To overcome these challenges, we propose a multimodal framework that leverages pre-trained vision-language models for automatic pseudo-label generation, CLIP-guided synonym filtering, and GPT-based caption reconstruction. In our target-vocabulary-assisted pseudo-labeling setting, the framework first constructs pseudo segmentation masks, descriptive captions, and semantically aligned synonym sets using Grounded SAM, LLaVA, and CLIP, providing multimodal supervision without manual annotation. translated_title: 从多模态伪标签中学习以实现鲁棒的开放词汇实例与全景分割
translated_abstract: 本文解决了开放词汇实例分割（OVIS）和开放集全景分割（OSPS）的挑战，这些任务旨在无需详尽的人工标注即可识别预定义和未见过的对象类别。现有方法常常受到噪声伪掩码、视觉-文本基础对齐有限以及处理同义词或词汇外（OOV）单词困难等问题的影响。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种多模态框架，利用预训练的视觉-语言模型进行自动伪标签生成、CLIP引导的同义词过滤以及基于GPT的标题重建。在我们的目标词汇辅助伪标签设置中，该框架首先使用Grounded SAM、LLaVA和CLIP构建伪分割掩码、描述性标题和语义对齐的同义词集，提供无需人工标注的多模态监督。然后，我们通过三种互补方式增强视觉-文本对齐。
tldr: 提出了一种利用预训练视觉-语言模型自动生成多模态伪标签（包括掩码、标题和同义词）的框架，以解决开放词汇实例和全景分割中的噪声伪掩码和视觉-文本对齐问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a multimodal framework leveraging pre-trained vision-language models to automatically generate pseudo-labels (masks, captions, synonyms) for robust open-vocabulary instance and panoptic segmentation, addressing noisy pseudo-masks and visual-textual alignment.
